messages.subject: splitting strings in a column
parts:
In this example, I need to split the entries in one column and write the second value from the split into another column.  How can I do this using dplyr?

require(dplyr)
require(stringr)
options(width=200)

usr <- "user1"
data.frame(tname=c("member_user1_844bd91f90954b41bc5cde0134e19dd1", "matrix_user1_844bd91f90954b41bc5cde0134e19dd1", NA, "matrix_stuff")) %>% mutate(pars=str_split(tname,sprintf("_%s_",usr)))

I need to create a column
sess = c("844bd91f90954b41bc5cde0134e19dd1","844bd91f90954b41bc5cde0134e19dd1",NA,NA)
Look at each element in column pars...if it has two elements get the second element.  Else put in NA.

I know how to do this using sapply. 
df$sess <- sapply(df$pars, function(x) ifelse(length(x)==2,x[[2]],NA))

I was curious to know how this can be done in dplyr.  Thanks.
